title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E4 — Card Sharps
Fred is convinced that Lamont's card-playing buddies are trying to sock it to him for every cent he's got, but Lamont won't believe him. Fred's attempts at signaling Lamont create nothing but constant turmoil.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E5 — Whiplash
After Fred has an accident in the pick-up truck, he decides he is suffering from whiplash. Fred's friend Bubba (Don Bexley) convinces him he is sitting on a gold mine. Lamont, on the other hand, is sure his father is faking.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E6 — Have Gun, Will Sell
Lamont and his friend Rollo (Nathaniel Taylor) scare off a burglar in the Sanford house, but he leaves something behind -- a gun. Rollo convinces Fred and Lamont that they could make some money if they pawn the gun, but the scheme explodes.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E7 — The Dowry
Fred's cousin and his new bride visit from St. Louis with the idea of finding a husband for his cousin's new stepdaughter. When Fred learns there's a $10,000 dowry involved, he schemes to get Lamont to ask for her hand in marriage.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E14 — The Jefferson Curve
After watching George Jefferson in action, his young protege Marcus bends the truth to win the heart of a young lady and throws a curve that lands Lionel in foul territory.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E15 — 984 W. 124th., Apt. 5c
When Louise discovers that George has been sending presents and money to a mysterious address, she follows him to find out why and is shocked...and touched by what she sees.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E16 — George And Whitty
George and Louise are stunned by their landlord Whittendale's plans to evict them, but their biggest surprise is yet to come when they invite him down to discuss it.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E17 — Lionel Gets The Business
George is on cloud nine when he finally persuades Lionel to join him in the family's cleaning business -- until Lionel starts taking him to the cleaners.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E18 — Blackout, The
George blows a fuse when a power blackout hits the city and looters do the same to his store.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E19 — Florence's Union
Florence wants to form a union for maids and succeeds in breaking up the whole household.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E20 — George And Jimmy
When George calls President Carter as a publicity stunt, he gets more publicity than he expected and the Jeffersons get a night they'll never forget.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E21 — Thomas H. Willis & Co
When Tom Willis makes opening his own business more important than his family and friends, he may get the business but lose everything else.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S2 E5 — George Carlin, Pat Boone & Family, Sugar Ray Robinson
Flip sells ice cream; Flip & Carlin do a TV news spoof; Boone intros his family and the cast does a "To Tell A Lie" panel show sketch.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S2 E6 — The Supremes, Willie Tyler & Lester, David Frost
Flip plays a huckster; the Supremes join Flip & Frost for a secret agent and haunted castle skits; Willie Tyler does ventriloquism.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E17 — Shades of Soul! - Part 1
Felipe Luciano hosts this showcase of Latin music on Soul! Features musicians Tito Puente and Willie Colon, accompanied by their musical groups.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E18 — Shades of Soul! - Part 2
Female singing trio LaBelle and conga drum/bongo musician Mongo Santamaria, are guests of Ellis Haizlip.

title: Webster
description:
S6 E11 — Rich Man, Poor Man
When Katherine's rich uncle falls in love with the leading lady of a theatrical performance, Webster and Katherine's debuts are in danger.

title: Webster
description:
S6 E12 — Doing Time at the Community Center
A convicted gambler undergoing rehab has a profound influence on Webster.

title: Webster
description:
S6 E13 — Bowled Over
Katherine joins a bowling league hoping to persuade the sponsors to help with one of her programs, unaware they are such horrible people.

title: Webster
description:
S6 E14 — Ticket to Ride
Webster gets a brand new bike, but ends up getting a ticket from a cop.

title: Webster
description:
S6 E15 — The Science Project
When Frieda gets sick and can't make it to the science fair, Webster has to come to the rescue.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E6 — Twins Get Fired
When Tia becomes Tamera's new boss at Rocket Burger, they both learn a lesson in responsibility.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E7 — Halloween
While the twins go in search of a Halloween rave, Lisa and Ray attend a fancy party thrown by a prospective client.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E8 — Weird Science
Tia and Tamera think they're in for a "free ride" when Ray starts dating their science teacher.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E9 — Thanksgiving in Hawaii (Part I)
When Ray and Lisa take the girls to Hawaii for Thanksgiving, they're forced to share their condo with their "exes," who have begun dating each other.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E10 — Thanksgiving in Hawaii (Part II)
While Ray and Lisa frantically search for the twins, who are missing in Hawaii, Roger opens the Campbell/Landry home to hobos for Thanksgiving dinner.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E13 — OhMiGod, Fanatic
After Moesha and Kim have a huge fight, Moesha is surprised when MTV shows up at her door to film her bringing her best friend Kim to meet her favorite singer.  Leanne Rimes guest stars.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E16 — Jugglin'
While trying to help Holly, Malcolm finds himself juggling three dates at the same time.
